title: Use repository initials for non-EVE header marks
summary: Repository detail headers no longer use the EVE wordmark as a fallback for unrelated repositories. The EVE repository still renders the wordmark, while other repositories render a large readable initial in the same image area.
userVisibleChange: Opening an unrelated repository such as chart-performance-demo now shows its initial in the header image section instead of the EVE logo.

risks.title: Initial fallback may be generic for repositories sharing a first character
risks.mitigation: The repository name remains adjacent to the mark, and the change follows the user's request for an initial rather than a logo.

timeline.title: Added conditional repository header mark
timeline.summary: The repository page now renders the EVE wordmark only for the EVE repository and otherwise shows an initial-based mark.

timeline.title: Verified UI and Go test suites
timeline.summary: Ran UI tests, production build, Go tests, and focused repository page tests.

decisions.title: Keep the EVE wordmark scoped to the EVE repository
decisions.rationale: The wordmark is a product brand asset and reads as misleading when shown on unrelated repositories.

decisions.title: Use a single first readable character for fallback marks
decisions.rationale: The user asked for an initial in the image section, and a single uppercase character stays legible in the existing wide header slot.
